human_understanding_delta: Interpolating the actual polynomial at both endpoints of a root spoke by a trinomial makes every discarded mode carry t^k-t^j. The remainder therefore vanishes at both the hub and the root, while the trinomial has an exact positive three-term slack. This replaces the nonuniform literal-first-mode approximation by a finite multiscale certificate that can change exponents across subintervals.
unresolved_downstream_bottleneck: Prove a two-root finite interval selector whose exponentwise envelope certificates cover the truncated spokes and existing connector; a single exponent is not asserted to work globally.
next_stage_owner: Refinery: combine this endpoint-vanishing certificate with the origin-anchored finite Fourier expansion and the existing geometric reduction.
claim_ceiling: This proves a sharp conditional spoke certificate, not the unrestricted Erdős #1041 theorem.
